scope: Android fullscreen template editor and bottom option sheets
changes: Android-only fullscreen editor with fixed cancel/save header and one scrolling form
Vertical field rows, with a single column of choices below 360 CSS pixels
Bottom sheets for field types, sensitivity, destination page, icon and plugin binding
Selected type is supplied directly when adding a field; the new name receives focus
Option drafts support cancel and remove blank or duplicate values only on confirmation
Dynamic field settings and archived field restore/cleanup remain available
Nested back, focus restoration, keyboard insets, safe areas and external-navigation cleanup
preserved: Windows/macOS desktop dialog and inline controls
Existing template persistence and save-error handling
Field-usage checks, archive confirmation and restore behavior
Plugin contract derivation and binding persistence
The final allowed dynamic field type cannot be deselected
